Which molecular formulas are shared by the most PubChem compounds?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity came from hydroelectric dams in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.HYC-US-99.A' AND period = '2023'
Which kinds of magnetic ordering are most common among computed materials?
SELECT ordering, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many professional, scientific and technical jobs were in Santa Clara County in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cns12 AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ca' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '06085'
Which cities are home to the most federal political committees?
SELECT cmte_city, cmte_st, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How has average behind-the-meter solar output in central New York grown year by year?
SELECT substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) AS year, avg(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual WHERE zone_name = 'CENTRL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which companies operate the most natural gas pipeline segments?
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_pipelines WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the pharmacy acquisition cost of Lantus insulin changed year by year?

SELECT substr(effective_date, 7, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 2) AS avg_cost_per_unit FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'LANTUS%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
What makes of vehicle were the drivers killed in 2022 crashes driving?
SELECT makename, count(*) AS drivers_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '1' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies reported a revenue figure for calendar 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept IN ('Revenues', 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax') AND frame = 'CY2023'
What were the most common reasons lenders gave for turning down mortgages in 2010?

SELECT CASE trim(denial_reason_1) WHEN '1' THEN 'debt-to-income ratio' WHEN '2' THEN 'employment history' WHEN '3' THEN 'credit history' WHEN '4' THEN 'collateral' WHEN '5' THEN 'not enough cash' WHEN '6' THEN 'unverifiable information' WHEN '7' THEN 'incomplete application' WHEN '8' THEN 'mortgage insurance denied' ELSE 'other' END AS reason, count(*) AS denials FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2010' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' AND trim(denial_reason_1) <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many businesses registered in SAM.gov list a physical address in Montana?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'MT'
What kinds of facility report the most events to the NRC?
SELECT category, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average annual pay in securities and investment firms in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '15' AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '523' AND year = '2023'
Which vendors were paid the most by federal campaigns in 2024?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ZIP code areas reach into Kings County, New York?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 WHERE geoid_county_20 = '36047'
Which arXiv categories appear on the most papers, cross-listings included?
SELECT category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_categories GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did independent expenditures supporting candidates change from the 1996 cycle to 2006?

SELECT cast(cycle AS varchar) AS cycle, sum(transaction_amt) AS dollars FROM govblock_fec.committee_transactions WHERE transaction_tp = '24E' AND cast(cycle AS varchar) IN ('1996', '2006') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which school districts employ the most staff?

SELECT lea_name, st, round(try_cast(staff_count AS double)) AS staff FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059 WHERE school_year = (SELECT max(school_year) FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059) AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How much child support did the offset program collect from tax refunds in 2024?

SELECT sum(try_cast(net_offset_amt AS double)) AS collected FROM govblock_treasury.treasury_offset_program WHERE mixed_stream LIKE 'Tax Refund - Child Sup%' AND substr(cast(record_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
Which companies spent the most on research and development in calendar 2023?

SELECT entity_name, max(try_cast(val AS double)) AS research_and_development FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept IN ('ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense') AND frame = 'CY2023' AND unit = 'USD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the largest number of claims in one published application?
SELECT max(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)) AS most_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which agencies recover the most money through Treasury offsets?
SELECT agency_nm, sum(try_cast(net_offset_amt AS double)) AS collected FROM govblock_treasury.treasury_offset_program WHERE agency_nm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audit findings repeat a finding from an earlier year?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_repeat_finding AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_findings
Which violations are cited most often in EPA enforcement cases?
SELECT violation_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_violations WHERE violation_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do the two chambers of the Texas legislature compare in size?
SELECT chamber, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'tx-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which agencies have sent the most rules to the White House regulatory office for review?

SELECT a.name AS agency, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed e JOIN govblock_executive.oira_agy_agency_list a ON a.agency_code = e.agency_code GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census-designated places, unincorporated communities, does the Census Bureau define?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid) AS cdps FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE name LIKE '% CDP'
Which counties report the most arthritis among adults?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'ARTHRITIS' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How large was New York State's labour force in 2024?
SELECT value AS labor_force FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000006' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M13'
At which companies did insiders sell the most stock by value in 2023?

SELECT s.issuername, round(sum(try_cast(t.trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(t.trans_pricepershare AS double))) AS dollars_sold FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans t JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s ON s.accession_number = t.accession_number WHERE t.trans_code = 'S' AND t.trans_date LIKE '%-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules are in the 50-million sample of GDB-17?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb17_50000000
Which day of the week was deadliest on American roads in 2022?
SELECT day_weekname, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Maricopa County, Arizona split between the presidential candidates in 2024?

SELECT candidate, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'ARIZONA' AND county_name = 'MARICOPA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6
Which countries issued the most drug warnings recorded in ChEMBL?
SELECT warning_country, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of testosterone?
SELECT c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '6013'
Which states have the most statute sections in force?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'statute' AND act_status = 'in_force' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '4091'
Which states drew the most from the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2020?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '21-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many plant patents cover roses?
SELECT count(*) AS plant_patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_botanic WHERE latin_name LIKE 'Rosa%'
Which companies have been named as defendants in the most patent lawsuits?
SELECT name, count(DISTINCT case_row_id) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_names WHERE party_type = 'Defendant' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the exact mass of caffeine, in daltons?
SELECT try_cast(c2 AS double) AS exact_mass FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '2519'
Which states have the largest legislatures?
SELECT upper(substr(state_file, 1, 2)) AS state, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people were hired across the U.S. economy in December 2024?
SELECT value AS hires_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000HIL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which reliability regions had the most units reporting to EPA in 2023?
SELECT nerc_region, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND nerc_region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Is atorvastatin or rosuvastatin prescribed more often under Medicare in Ohio?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'OH' AND gnrc_name IN ('Atorvastatin Calcium', 'Rosuvastatin Calcium') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
